cues: Keeping novels upright and visible makes choosing the next read easier during a quiet evening.
A dedicated place for books prevents favorite titles from becoming buried beneath everyday papers.
Arranging reading material vertically frees table space while keeping frequently consulted references close at hand.
Displayed spines invite visitors to browse and discover authors they might otherwise overlook.
Grouping books by subject helps students locate sources quickly when an assignment sends them searching.
A home library gains an orderly focal point when stories and reference works share a visible place.
